description: Implement the frontend ApiRepository that satisfies the existing synchronous Repository interface by talking to the FEAT-002 backend, and wire it in for production while keeping the 61 existing domain/store tests passing. This depends on FEAT-002 (the API must exist). The critical constraint: the Repository interface is synchronous (snapshot(): Db, createUser(): User, openDirectChat(): ChatId, sendGift()/addFriendByCode()/giftAction() return objects read inline), so ApiRepository keeps an in-memory Db mirror hydrated from GET /api/snapshot and kept live via the WebSocket, applies mutations optimistically to the mirror while firing async HTTP calls, and reconciles from server responses/WS pushes.
steps: Create src/store/apiRepository.ts implementing Repository from src/store/repository.ts WITHOUT changing the interface. Hold a private in-memory `Db` (start from emptyDb()), a `serialized` string and a listener Set exactly like LocalRepository, and expose snapshot()/subscribe() returning the mirror synchronously and only emitting on real content change (reuse the LocalRepository no-emit-on-no-change discipline to avoid React #185 loops).

Hydration + realtime: on construction, fetch GET /api/snapshot (credentials: 'include' for the session cookie) and populate the mirror, emitting once loaded; open a WebSocket to /ws and on server change signals re-fetch the snapshot (or apply pushed deltas) and emit only if content changed. Handle reconnect.

Implement each command against the mirror + server. For synchronous-return methods, apply an optimistic local update so the immediate return value is correct, then POST to the API and reconcile: createUser(name) must return a User synchronously — generate the user via the server (the app calls signIn(user.id) right after); since the interface is sync, either (a) create locally with a provisional id then reconcile, or (b) make createUser drive a synchronous-looking flow — prefer applying the server's authoritative user on the next snapshot and returning a locally-constructed User whose id matches what StoreProvider will sign in with. Keep openDirectChat returning a stable ChatId (use directChatBetween on the mirror if present, else create optimistically with a deterministic/temporary id reconciled to the server id — ensure the returned id resolves to a real chat after reconciliation, mirroring the localRepository 'ghost id' regression test concern). sendMessage/markRead/toggleFavorite/removeFriend update the mirror then fire-and-forget POSTs. addFriendByCode/sendGift/giftAction return {ok,...} — validate against the mirror using the same domain selectors/checkGiftAction for immediate feedback, then POST; on server rejection, roll back the optimistic change and surface the server's reason. Use idempotency keys on message/gift/chat POSTs matching FEAT-002.

reset(): in production this should be a no-op or throw (localRepository.reset is demo-only and the production API must not expose reset). Keep the method present to satisfy the interface but do not wire a destructive server call unless a documented dev-only endpoint exists.

Wire selection of repository: update src/store/StoreProvider.tsx and/or src/main.tsx so production uses ApiRepository (pointing at a configurable API base URL via a Vite env var like VITE_API_BASE, defaulting to the local backend) while tests and the pure-localStorage demo mode can still use LocalRepository. Do NOT break the `repository?` injection prop used by tests. Auth wiring: signIn/signOut currently use sessionStorage for the current user id; align this with the server session — e.g. after createUser or selecting an existing user, call the backend to establish the session cookie, and derive `me` from GET /api/auth/me / the snapshot. Keep transient screen state in the frontend; localStorage may only hold non-sensitive disposable UI prefs.

Add unit tests for ApiRepository (src/store/apiRepository.test.ts) using vitest with a mocked fetch + a fake WebSocket, mirroring the style of localRepository.test.ts: snapshot/subscribe emit-on-change discipline, optimistic openDirectChat returns a resolvable id, message send updates the mirror and posts, gift accept updates the bubble state, and rejected gift actions roll back. These are in addition to (not replacing) the existing 61 tests.
Confirm the whole frontend still typechecks and builds and that all existing tests plus the new ApiRepository tests pass: `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` at repo root.
acceptance_criteria: src/store/apiRepository.ts implements Repository with zero changes to the Repository interface signatures.
snapshot() returns the in-memory Db synchronously; subscribe() drives useSyncExternalStore and only fires on real content change (no infinite render loop).
Mutations update the mirror and call the backend; server rejections roll back optimistic changes and surface the human-readable reason.
Production wiring uses ApiRepository via a configurable API base URL; tests can still inject LocalRepository through the existing repository? prop.
The existing 61 tests still pass unchanged, and new ApiRepository tests pass.
`npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` at repo root succeed.
verification: At repo root: `npm test` (existing 61 + new ApiRepository tests all pass), `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`.
Confirm no signature changes to src/store/repository.ts via `git diff`.
Type-level: ApiRepository is assignable to Repository (compiler enforces via `implements Repository`).
findings:
COMPLETED on branch feat/backend. Frontend now selects a repository at runtime: ApiRepository when VITE_API_BASE is set, LocalRepository otherwise; tests still inject via the existing `repository?` prop. Verified at repo root: `npm test` (77 tests = 61 existing unchanged + 16 new ApiRepository tests), `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build` all green. `git diff src/store/repository.ts` is EMPTY — zero signature changes to the synchronous contract; ApiRepository compiles as `implements Repository` so the compiler enforces the contract.

WHAT SHIPPED:
- src/store/apiRepository.ts (ApiRepository implements Repository): holds an in-memory Db mirror (starts emptyDb()), a `serialized` string + listener Set exactly like LocalRepository, and only emits on real content change (JSON compare) to avoid React #185 loops. Hydrates from GET /api/snapshot (credentials:'include'); opens a WebSocket to /ws and on {type:'change'} re-fetches the snapshot (refresh() serialized via a promise chain so overlapping fetches keep order) and emits only if content changed; reconnects with a 1.5s backoff and re-hydrates on reconnect. All mutators update the mirror OPTIMISTICALLY (so the synchronous return is correct) then fire async fetch() and reconcile/rollback on the server response. Optimistic validation + reason strings reuse the SAME domain code as localRepository (normalizeCode/findUserByCode/isFriend/unreadCount/directChatBetween, checkGiftAction/applyGiftAction/newGiftOrder) so behavior/messages match. createUser inserts a provisional user and returns it synchronously (so StoreProvider's signIn(user.id) works), then POSTs /api/auth/session {name} and adopts the server's authoritative user on response. openDirectChat returns a stable temp id that resolves to a real chat, reconciled to the server chatId (rewrites chat/message/read references) — mirrors the localRepository ghost-id concern. sendMessage/markRead/toggleFavorite/removeFriend update mirror then fire-and-forget with rollback on failure. addFriendByCode/sendGift/giftAction return {ok,...} inline and roll back on server rejection. Idempotency uses body `clientKey` (localId/orderId) on message/gift POSTs matching FEAT-002. reset() THROWS (production API exposes no reset). FORCE_EXPIRE is rejected locally too. Extra session methods (signInExisting/currentUser/signOutSession) live OUTSIDE the Repository interface (StoreProvider duck-types them) so the sync contract is untouched.
- src/store/config.ts: apiBaseUrl() reads import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE (safely), returns null when unset (local demo mode).
- src/store/StoreProvider.tsx: selects ApiRepository (VITE_API_BASE) vs LocalRepository (default), preserving the `repository?` injection prop. signIn now also calls repo.signInExisting(id) to establish the server session cookie; signOut calls signOutSession(); on mount with no meId it restores `me` from GET /api/auth/me. Does NOT auto-signOut in server mode when the snapshot hasn't hydrated yet (avoids logging out before hydration).
- src/store/apiRepository.test.ts (16 tests, vitest): mocked fetch (FakeBackend) + fake WebSocket (FakeSocket). Covers hydrate-emits-once, no-emit on identical snapshot (React #185), createUser provisional->server reconcile, optimistic openDirectChat returns a resolvable id + reconciles to server id + single room on reuse, sendMessage updates mirror+posts and own msg not unread, empty message no-op, markRead no-wake when nothing to read, gift accept flips bubble to accepted, self-gift rejected by domain reason without server call, non-party gift action rejected with domain reason, FORCE_EXPIRE rejected locally, server-rejected gift action rolls back to paid, addFriendByCode rollback on server rejection, WebSocket change signal triggers re-fetch, reset() throws.

NOTE: FEAT-003 unit tests do NOT need a live backend (fetch + WebSocket are mocked). The real end-to-end run against the live server is FEAT-004. LoginScreen copy still says 'no server' but that is demo-mode-accurate; left unchanged to keep scope focused.
